text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Bloor Street West, City Council approval of this report is required. The purpose of this report is to respond to Toronto and East York Community Council's direction to review and report back on the realignment of Permit Parking Area 2 to exclude the development located at 1319 Bloor Street West. Staff have determined the realignment of the Permit Parking Area 2 is feasible and has no objections to excluding the development located at 1319 Bloor Street West. If City Council excludes this address from the subject Permit Parking Area, residents and visitors of this address will be prohibited from participating in the on-street permit parking program.

City Council on July 19, 20, 21 and 22, 2022, adopted the following: 1. City Council amend Schedule B of the City of Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 925, Permit Parking, to incorporate a revised map of Permit Parking Area 2, as shown in Attachment 1 to the report (June 2, 2022) from the Director, Permits and Enforcement, Transportation Services.
